title: Power
wikitext:
'''Power''' is a mechanic used to calculate certain skills and effects, primarily [[Warcry|warcries]].

==Mechanics==
Enemy [[monster]]s and players have a number of power based on their [[rarity]]. 

* {{c|normal|Normal}} enemies have 1 Power.
* {{c|magic|Magic}} enemies have 5 Power.
* {{c|rare|Rare}} enemies have 10 Power.
* {{c|unique|Unique}} enemies have 20 Power.
* Players have 5 Power.

}}

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.11.0|
* Each [[Warcry]] is enhanced by the proximity of enemies, and for some warcries, [[Ally|allies]] or [[Kill#Corpses|corpses]] too. This is measured as 'Power', with Normal enemies providing 1 Power, Magic enemies providing 2, Rare enemies providing 10, Unique enemies providing 20, and players providing 5. All Warcries also [[taunt]] enemies in range.
}}
